name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: This role is about fixing the problem in front of a customer quickly and leaving the account in better shape than you found it. That's the part of customer work I like best. I've worked formal support-ticket queues in Zendesk, handled 50+ partner activities a day at Birdeye, and logged every outcome in Salesforce so the next person has the full picture.

I also understand why your customers care so much about getting things right. I served a banking client at Fetch & Funnel, and earlier I co-owned a licensed, highly regulated retail business where I built the compliance systems from scratch. At Accelo I walked clients through invoicing and billing, so contract and invoice questions don't rattle me.
I'm applying for an entry-level seat on purpose. I want to do this work well at a company where accuracy matters. Open to a conversation at 303-726-5037 or jrotnbrg@gmail.com.
